name: Glide
description: The default theme every app reads (Glide on Tern, Dash, Hermes desktop, the phones). Light is the kit's default light (T3 Code light); dark is Glide's Tern window theme (Dash black and gold). Values are copied from their sources unchanged, so wearing this file changes nothing on screen today.

brand.name: Glide
brand.tagline: An agent workspace that guards two scarce resources: your attention and the agent's context window.

family.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Inter Variable", Inter, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
family.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

sources.color.light: ephemeral-ui src/data/themes.json t3-light (the kit's default light; T3 Code apps/web/src/index.css @ 54e9bb96)
sources.color.dark: glide glide/themes/dash.json vars (Glide's Tern window theme) @ 6c1e677: background, foreground, card, muted, mutedForeground, accent, border, primary, popover (sidebar), userBubble (message), green, yellow, destructive, red, faint, secondary, blue (info), magenta, cyan; input and sidebarBorder take border, primaryFg takes glide/frontend/tokens.ts GOLD.ink
sources.brand: glide README.md (tagline), glide/frontend/tokens.ts DASH.gold and GOLD, ephemeral-ui src/intel.html (Glide mark #e6cd96)
sources.radius: glide/frontend/tokens.ts RADIUS; base and lg are the kit's --h-radius (t3 radius 8) and --h-radius-lg (radius + 4, src/js/themes.js)
sources.space: ephemeral-ui src/styles.css: the paddings and gaps it uses most (2-24 px) and --pad (16px * --h-density)
sources.type: family: ephemeral-ui t3 font/mono and --serif; base: src/styles.css body; size and tracking: glide/frontend/tokens.ts TYPE and TRACK
sources.motion: easing and spring: ephemeral-ui src/js/motion.js ease and springs; glass easing: glide/frontend/glass.ts --g-ease; duration: glass.ts hover lifts (.15s/.18s/.2s), src/styles.css .25s, motion.js anim() default 400, themes.js setTheme reveal 620; speed: src/index.html #c-speed (0.5-2), durations divide by speed, so turbo 2 halves them
sources.glass: ephemeral-ui src/styles.css (#drawer scrim 3, #palette backdrop 4, header.top 16/1.3 at 82%, Hermes composer 18/1.4 at 72%); glide/frontend/glass.ts frost 22px/140% and the playground's 44px/220% ceiling
